title: Darren Mougey confirms the Jets will use franchise tag or transition tag on Breece Hall if no long-term deal is worked out

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Darren Mougey confirms the Jets will use franchise tag or transition tag on Breece Hall if no long-term deal is worked out
sources.description: The top Jets player hitting free agency is running back Breece Hall. His future with the team is up in the air. At his press conference during the NFL Scouting Combine, Mougey reportedly suggested that the Jets intend to keep Hall. The team will pursue a long-term extension before the start of free agency.
